name: The one called (munādā)
definition: The noun called with yā or its sisters: of five kinds, two built on ḍamma and three in naṣb.
body: A single proper name (yā zaydu) and an indefinite noun meaning someone in particular (yā rajulu, 'O man' to one man before you) are built on ḍamma without tanwīn.
An indefinite noun meaning no one in particular, the muḍāf (yā ʿabda llāhi) and what is like a muḍāf are in naṣb.
